saw_lines: Bed buyers decide on feel, not logo, and they compare firmness and warmth for weeks before they commit.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a buyer decides whether your bed deserves a comparison.
Your 28 live ads include 0 videos, so shoot three short clips of the duvet and pillow in use and test them against your top static ad.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: 0 of your 28 live ads are video, so nobody sees the bed in motion before they click. Shoot three short videos of the duvet and pillow in use, then run them against your top static ad.
No proof number in your ads

None of your 28 live ads shows a proof number, so a buyer comparing beds has nothing concrete to hold on to. Collect one real figure, like your review count or orders shipped, and lead every new ad with it.
Your 20% sale is a seasonal price line, and no ad gives a first time buyer a reason to act today. Put a first order offer or a bundle price in the first line of three new ads.
All 28 of your ads end on Shop now, yet they send buyers to 7 different pages. A pillow shopper who lands on a mattress page sees a mismatch and leaves. Match each button to its page.
